prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an entirely new polished full-color Japanese workplace manga illustration for a camper repair website. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Scene: an adult Japanese mechanic in his early 30s replacing a FRONT HEADLIGHT ASSEMBLY on a cream cab-over motorhome inside an airy local garage. He has a clean-shaven angular but approachable face, expressive medium almond-shaped eyes, softly wavy short black hair with restrained highlights, charcoal work coveralls over off-white T-shirt. He is on LEFT in three-quarter side view, focused on the headlight at RIGHT, no camera eye contact. Medium close-up framing prominently shows his face, both hands, the headlight and the camper's recognizable front corner. The mechanic supports a clear rectangular headlamp assembly just outside its mounting aperture with his left hand, while his right hand is reconnecting a single electrical plug at the rear of the assembly. Depict ONE headlight assembly, plausible black rear housing, short slack wire harness leading to the matching rectangular empty mounting aperture. The lamp's clear lens and reflective facets are visible in slight three-quarter view. The headlamp is held only 10–15 cm away from the opening, not floating, without cutting through body panels. No wheel repair or tire tools. Keep both hands readable, anatomically correct, with five fingers, no impossible grip. The camper cab includes its cream panelwork, olive stripe, side mirror and part of windshield so the vehicle type reads immediately. Garage background: softly simplified green metal tool cabinet and warm daylight from open doorway, with hints of trees outdoors. Existing site's visual identity: clean precise dark ink contours of moderate thickness, simplified two-tone cel shading, warm cream/olive/charcoal colors, handsome adult manga proportions, crisp shadow shapes, limited hatching, no painterly or photorealistic rendering. Composition should be immediately understandable on a 390px mobile card, with the headlight exchange action central and clearly visible. Natural professional focused expression, no grin to camera, not a pose. Edge-to-edge rectangular image, entire mechanic head and working hands within frame. No other people, no written words, brand logos, text, bubbles, decorative border or watermark. A trustworthy, specific service scene, not generic tool holding.
